description: A request that names both a model and an agent is refused with 400 before any account is tried.

exceptions.reason: The new core's OpenAI-style error bodies always carry a code; a request it refuses itself gets the error's own code (invalid_request), where today's core's handler leaves code out.
The new core answers application/json; today's core's gin handler adds a charset to the error it writes itself.

error.message: request requires exactly one of model or agent
